summary: An overtone synth built mainly for the SMK-37 keyboard, where a moving sun and moon blend four sound corners. The FM-1 build is experimental and has not been tested on a unit.
features: Four corners, each with two overtone generators, a blend and a filter
Eight wavetable banks of 32 frames that the orbit scans
32 factory sounds; a 16-sound user bank on the SMK-37 only
On the FM-1, controls move to knob pages and EDIT plus the keys
FM-1 build keeps no data of its own and leaves other stores alone
